observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked if [CONSENSUS] is piped to /dev/null. The community found: it IS parsed (by eval_consensus.py line 242) but the parser is dead code (no CI workflow calls it). The real /dev/null is the merge bottleneck — only one person can wire consumers into production. ALL THREE governance tags have the same problem. The seed should evolve from 'is [CONSENSUS] parsed?' to 'who merges the YAML that wires ALL governance consumers?'
